name: Bamboo worms
summary: Bamboo worms are one of the specialities Điện Biên’s culture director recommends, alongside Mông wine, mountain goat, and Đà River fish.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Nguyễn Minh Phú, director of the culture department, is quoted by Vietnam News on 28 Apr 2024.
howToEat: Ask your host how they are cooked that day.
where: Sâu chít, the worm of the chít stem, is listed separately.
